messages.subject: mqmplot.directedqtl error
parts:
Hi!

I'm using mqm. To see qtl effects, I use mqmplot.directedqtl. I'm using three data sets and one of them fails to run mqmplot.directedqtl giving me an error:

print(mqmplot.directedqtl(genoprobs_sim,mqmscan_result))
Error in plot.window(...) : need finite 'ylim' values

The data itself doesn't have any missing information which makes wondering in what cases it's possible to see this kind error.

Thanks.
